description: Axon Enterprise, Inc. is a technology company that provides integrated hardware and software solutions, founder-led since 1993 and grown from a mission to protect life into a global technology company serving a range of customers across the public and private sector. Its products and services allow customers to capture and use critical data to support fully-connected operational workflows, and its trusted network seamlessly integrates software and hardware with a range of connected devices, including TASER energy devices, cameras and sensors, drones and robotics, cloud-based evidence management, records management, real-time operations software, critical incident and emergency response systems, immersive training and productivity tools, all enhanced by artificial intelligence. Its subscription software as a service solutions are organized into categories including Digital Evidence Management, with Axon Evidence, a secure cloud-based platform that enables public safety to store, manage and share critical evidence while ensuring chain of custody and compliance, and Productivity Solutions, including Axon Records, Axon Standards and AI Era Plan solutions such as Real-Time Translation, Draft One, Policy Chat and Auto-Transcribe.
